preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: 2 <= len(s) <= 50 and all(c in 'EN' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Each test case string s must have a length between 2 and 50 and consist only of characters 'E' and 'N'.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case must be either 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: any(s[i] == 'E' for i in range(len(s))) and any(s[i] == 'N' for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: If the output is 'YES', there must be at least one 'E' and one 'N' in the string s.
